section.title: org.osgi.service.zigbee.descriptions
section.para: Device Service Specification for ZigBee Technology Descriptions.

This package contains the interfaces for descriptions. The latter may be used to embed meta information about the ZigBee devices, and in other words a meta description of each device type present in a ZCL profile, or even custom devices.
It is not mandatory to provide this meta model for being able to interact with a specific device, but the presence of this meta model would make much easier to implement, for example user interfaces.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.zigbee.descriptions; version="[1.0,2.0)"}
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.zigbee.descriptions; version="[1.0,1.1)"}

section.title: public abstract ZCLSimpleTypeDescription extends ZCLDataTypeDescription
section.para: This interface is used for representing any of the simple ZigBee Data Types defined in the ZCL.

The interface extends the {@link ZCLDataTypeDescription} by providing serialize and deserialize methods to marshal and unmarshal the data into the {@link ZigBeeDataInput} and from {@link ZigBeeDataOutput} streams.
Related documentation: [1] ZigBee Cluster Library specification, Document 075123r04ZB, May 29, 2012.

formalpara.title: No Implement
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this interface

section.title: public abstract Object deserialize(ZigBeeDataInput is) throws IOException

formalpara.title: is
formalpara.para: the {@link ZigBeeDataInput} from where the value of data type is read from.

section.para: Deserializes a value from the passed {@link ZigBeeDataInput} stream.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: An object that represents the deserialized value of data. Returns {@code null} if the read value represents the Invalid Value for the specific ZigBee data type.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: NullPointerException– If {@link ZigBeeDataInput} parameter is {@code null}.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an I/O error occurs while reading the {@link ZigBeeDataInput}. An {@link EOFException} is thrown if the data input stream end is reached while deserializing the data type.

section.title: public abstract void serialize(ZigBeeDataOutput os, Object value) throws IOException

formalpara.title: os
formalpara.para: a {@link ZigBeeDataOutput} stream where to the passed value will be appended. This parameter cannot be {@code null}. If {@code null} a {@link NullPointerException} must be thrown.

formalpara.title: value
formalpara.para: The value that have to be serialized on the output stream. If null is passed this method outputs on the stream the ZigBee invalid value related the specific data type. If the data type do not allow any invalid value and the passed value is null an {@link IllegalArgumentException} is thrown.

section.para: Serializes a ZigBee data type into a {@link ZigBeeDataOutput} stream. An implementation of this method must throw an {@link IllegalArgumentException} if the passed value does not belong to the expected class or its value exceeds the possible values allowed (in terms of range or length).
An implementation of this method must interpret (where it makes sense) a {@code null} value as the request to serialize the so called Invalid Value.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an I/O error occurs while writing on the {@link ZigBeeDataOutput}. The {@link EOFException} may be thrown if there is no more space on the data output for serializing the passed value.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: NullPointerException– If {@link ZigBeeDataOutput} parameter is {@code null}.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– If the passed value parameter does not belong to the expected class or its value exceeds the possible values allowed (range or length).

section.title: public abstract ZigBeeDeviceDescriptionSet
section.para:
This interface represents a ZigBee Device description Set. A Set is registered as an OSGi Service that provides method to retrieve endpoint descriptions.
In addition to the ZigBeeDeviceDescriptionSet's (OSGi service) properties; ZigBeeDeviceDescriptionSet is also expected to be registered as an OSGi service with the following {@link ZigBeeEndpoint#PROFILE_ID}, and {@link ZigBeeNode#MANUFACTURER_CODE} properties.

section.title: public static final String DEVICES = "zigbee.profile.devices"
section.para:
Property key for a comma separated list of devices identifiers supported by the set.
This property is mandatory.

section.title: public static final String PROFILE_NAME = "zigbee.profile.name"
section.para:
Property key for a profile name.
This property is mandatory.

section.title: public static final String VERSION = "zigbee.profile.version"
section.para:
Property key for a version of the application profile. The format is 'major.minor' with major and minor being integers.
This property is mandatory.
